_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Blazing Retribution#000.src: Speak to Piere in the {p} Plains at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Blazing Retribution#000.dst: 前往 {p} 平原與 Piere 交談，座標 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Blazing Retribution#001.src: Oh sweet baby bovine, my house, what am I going to do? Wait, who are you?
Blazing Retribution#001.dst: 噢我的老天爺，我的房子，我該怎麼辦？等等，你是誰？
Blazing Retribution#001.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#002.src: Oh, a Human. Did the {p} authorities send you?
Blazing Retribution#002.dst: 噢，是人類。是 {p} 當局派你來的嗎？
Blazing Retribution#002.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#003.src: Detective Jackson has already been here. Not that he's doing anything useful.
Blazing Retribution#003.dst: Jackson 警探已經來過了。不過他也沒做什麼有用的事。
Blazing Retribution#003.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#004.src: An Orc managed to find some fire-imbued magical axe and burned down my house! Jackson didn't even call a firefighter!!
Blazing Retribution#004.dst: 有個獸人不知從哪弄來一把附了火的魔法斧頭，把我家給燒了！Jackson 連消防員都沒叫！！
Blazing Retribution#004.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#005.src: I don't know what to do, but maybe if you find Detective Jackson, you can kick his sorry rear into gear...
Blazing Retribution#005.dst: 我不知道該怎麼辦，但你要是找得到 Jackson 警探，或許能踹他一腳讓他動起來……
Blazing Retribution#005.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#006.src: The Orcs are already savage brutes. If they really have their hands on magical weapons, we're all in trouble!
Blazing Retribution#006.dst: 獸人本來就是野蠻的畜生。要是真讓他們拿到了魔法武器，我們全都有麻煩了！
Blazing Retribution#006.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#007.src: I believe Detective Jackson is by his cart "planning his next move." He's not far from here. Just continue past my farm!
Blazing Retribution#007.dst: 我想 Jackson 警探正在他的推車旁「規劃下一步」。離這裡不遠，穿過我的農場一直走就是了！
Blazing Retribution#007.speaker: Piere

Blazing Retribution#008.src: Report the attack to Detective Jackson at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Blazing Retribution#008.dst: 向 Jackson 警探回報這起攻擊，座標 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Blazing Retribution#009.src: How can I go about this...? I can't get involved myself, and they won't let me near... Wait, a human?
Blazing Retribution#009.dst: 這該怎麼辦才好……？我自己不能插手，他們又不讓我靠近……等等，人類？
Blazing Retribution#009.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#010.src: ...what do you MEAN "what am I doing?" This is a delicate situation! I need to- wait...actually, you might just be the help I need.
Blazing Retribution#010.dst: ……你說「我在做什麼」是什麼意思？這是很微妙的局面！我需要——等等……其實，你或許正是我需要的幫手。
Blazing Retribution#010.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#011.src: I'll give you the lowdown- we believe the orcs stole magical weaponry from within {p}, particularly a flaming axe.
Blazing Retribution#011.dst: 我把來龍去脈講給你聽——我們認為獸人從 {p} 境內偷走了魔法武器，特別是一把燃火的斧頭。
Blazing Retribution#011.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#012.src: However, that's a loophole in the ceasefire we had enacted with the Orcs. Theft isn't considered an act of aggression...
Blazing Retribution#012.dst: 不過那正是我們跟獸人簽的停火協議裡的漏洞。偷竊不算侵略行為……
Blazing Retribution#012.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#013.src: And that means my hands are tied. Humans, however, were not mentioned in the notes, so you'll need to retrieve it.
Blazing Retribution#013.dst: 也就是說我綁手綁腳。但條文裡沒提到人類，所以得由你去把它取回來。
Blazing Retribution#013.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#014.src: Our only saving grace is that it'll be impossible for them to replicate its power- Orcs are hilariously inept at magic.
Blazing Retribution#014.dst: 唯一慶幸的是他們不可能複製那份力量——獸人在魔法上笨拙得可笑。
Blazing Retribution#014.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#015.src: But, to the primary problem- You've probably seen how many orc camps are around here. Searching will take a long while...
Blazing Retribution#015.dst: 回到正題——你大概也看到這附近有多少獸人營地了。一個個找會花上很久……
Blazing Retribution#015.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#016.src: My only leads are that the "Sablestone" and "Loamsprout" camps seem to be celebrating recently. Best to start there, yes?
Blazing Retribution#016.dst: 我手上的線索只有：「Sablestone」和「Loamsprout」這兩座營地最近似乎在慶祝什麼。從那裡下手最好，對吧？
Blazing Retribution#016.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#017.src: Just to review- You need to search those two camps for the Axe of {p}, and then return it to me if you find it.
Blazing Retribution#017.dst: 再確認一次——你要去那兩座營地找 {p} 之斧，找到的話就帶回來給我。
Blazing Retribution#017.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#018.src: Sablestone is to the north, and Loamsprout to the south. They will be guarded, so don't be afraid to knock some heads.
Blazing Retribution#018.dst: Sablestone 在北邊，Loamsprout 在南邊。那裡都有人看守，該敲的頭別客氣。
Blazing Retribution#018.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#019.src: Look for the stolen weapon at the Sablestone and Loamsprout Orc camps
Blazing Retribution#019.dst: 到 Sablestone 與 Loamsprout 獸人營地尋找被偷走的武器

Blazing Retribution#020.src: Return to Detective Jackson with the news
Blazing Retribution#020.dst: 把消息帶回給 Jackson 警探

Blazing Retribution#021.src: I see no axe in your hands, so I should assume neither Sablestone or Loamsprout had it.
Blazing Retribution#021.dst: 你手上沒有斧頭，那我只能假設 Sablestone 和 Loamsprout 都沒有。
Blazing Retribution#021.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#022.src: Wait, really? A stick was the most powerful weapon they had? And Loamsprout...threw their dinner at you...?
Blazing Retribution#022.dst: 等等，真的假的？他們最強的武器是一根棍子？然後 Loamsprout……把晚餐扔向你……？
Blazing Retribution#022.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#023.src: I can't believe this! How are those...those THINGS outsmarting us?! Are they shuffling the axe between camps?
Blazing Retribution#023.dst: 我不敢相信！那些……那些東西怎麼可能比我們聰明？！他們是在營地之間輪流藏那把斧頭嗎？
Blazing Retribution#023.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#024.src: There are over a dozen camps between the Orcs and Goblins that they could be swapping it between!
Blazing Retribution#024.dst: 獸人和哥布林之間有十幾座營地可以互相傳來傳去！
Blazing Retribution#024.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#025.src: What if the GOBLINS get a hold of it?! They're the cleverest by half of all of them, so that could actually be a threat!
Blazing Retribution#025.dst: 要是被哥布林拿到怎麼辦？！那群傢伙的腦子比誰都好使，那才真的會出事！
Blazing Retribution#025.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#026.src: Searching all the camps one by one will be far too slow, gah!! How am I going to fix this?!
Blazing Retribution#026.dst: 一座一座找實在太慢了，啊啊！！我到底要怎麼收拾這個爛攤子？！
Blazing Retribution#026.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#027.src: There's Earthpit, and Cliffhearth, Shineridge and Stonecave, Sunspark, Mudspring, Holehold, I-
Blazing Retribution#027.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#028.src: Fire! Stop!! I hold magic cutter! LISTEN TO POXPER!!
Blazing Retribution#028.dst: 火！停下！！我拿魔法砍刀！聽 Poxper 的話！！

Blazing Retribution#029.src: I- I can't believe it, that has to be the one! AFTER THAT ORC, NOW!!
Blazing Retribution#029.dst: 我——我不敢相信，一定就是那個！快追那個獸人，馬上！！
Blazing Retribution#029.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#030.src: Find the hidden camp in the water near Piere's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Blazing Retribution#030.dst: 在 Piere 家附近的水裡找到隱藏的營地，座標 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Blazing Retribution#033.src: Uthniiazek! Uthniiazek!! WHY NO LISTEN TO Poxper?
Blazing Retribution#033.dst: Uthniiazek！Uthniiazek！！為什麼不聽 Poxper 的話？
Blazing Retribution#033.speaker: Poxper

Blazing Retribution#034.src: Stupid Villager magic thing! Why fire no listen?
Blazing Retribution#034.dst: 笨村民的魔法東西！火為什麼不聽話？
Blazing Retribution#034.speaker: Poxper

Blazing Retribution#035.src: Poxper say thing and make fire...what else axe say? 'Azektoluth?'
Blazing Retribution#035.dst: Poxper 說話就會生火……斧頭還說什麼？「Azektoluth」？
Blazing Retribution#035.speaker: Poxper

Blazing Retribution#036.src: Hraahah! Poxper control fire! Fire- kill human with Poxper! Uthniiazek! Azektoluth!
Blazing Retribution#036.dst: 哈啊哈！Poxper 控制火！火——跟 Poxper 一起殺人類！Uthniiazek！Azektoluth！
Blazing Retribution#036.speaker: Poxper

Blazing Retribution#037.src: Return the Magic Axe to the Detective
Blazing Retribution#037.dst: 把魔法斧頭交還給警探

Blazing Retribution#038.src: That looks like the axe of {p} to me! Blue finish, hot to the touch- well done! What Orc boss had stolen it?
Blazing Retribution#038.dst: 在我看來那就是 {p} 之斧！藍色的漆面，摸起來燙手——幹得好！是哪個獸人頭目偷的？
Blazing Retribution#038.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#039.src: Poxper? That...hm. This could be bad. I've head that name, and he's a fairly prolific Orc chief. You killed him, right?
Blazing Retribution#039.dst: Poxper？那……嗯。這可能不妙。我聽過這個名字，他是個相當有名的獸人首領。你把他殺了，對吧？
Blazing Retribution#039.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#040.src: Mmm... Hopefully that Veretel won't catch wind of it. Regardless, you've done a great service for Villager-kind!
Blazing Retribution#040.dst: 唔……但願那個 Veretel 不會聽到風聲。無論如何，你為村民一族立了大功！
Blazing Retribution#040.speaker: Detective Jackson

Blazing Retribution#041.src: Here's your compensation for that. Thank you for the aid!
Blazing Retribution#041.dst: 這是給你的報酬。謝謝你的幫忙！
Blazing Retribution#041.speaker: Detective Jackson
